description: K₃NaP₂(O₃F)₂ crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3m1 space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one F atom. The K-F bond length is 2.66 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All K-O bond lengths are 2.91 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₃F tetrahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.44 Å. P is bonded to three equivalent O and one F atom to form PO₃F tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 26°. All P-O bond lengths are 1.52 Å. The P-F bond length is 1.66 Å. O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, and one P atom. F is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one K and one P atom.
